description: Revoke dialogs do not warn that a leaked bundle also contains the drive key, which revoking the API key does not invalidate.
expected: A note that file contents already readable with the drive key stay readable by the holder, with guidance.
actual: Dialog only says the API key stops working
suggested_fix: Add one sentence about the drive key to the dialog or docs.

description: A revoked sandbox gets `Warning: could not report the key backup for drive <id> to Agent Drive.` before `The API key is invalid or revoked.` The lead line misdirects and no recovery step is given.
expected: `The API key is invalid or revoked. Ask the owner for a new credentials bundle.`
suggested_fix: Suppress the backup warning on auth failure; add recovery hint.

description: Agent revoke dialog omits 'This cannot be undone.' that the key dialog has; titles are forced upper case, altering the agent name case, and the key dialog title includes the long '(issued by <machine>)' label.
expected: Same warning in both; title shows name as typed.
suggested_fix: Unify copy; do not uppercase user-supplied names.

description: Revoked agent row stays with no remove control and the header count `3 AGENTS` keeps counting it.
expected: Count of active agents or a way to hide revoked ones.
